title: ½ Crown - George V (2nd type)

obverse.description: Uncrowned portrait of King George V left, legend around.
obverse.lettering: GEORGIVS V DEI GRA: BRITT: OMN: REX
obverse.lettering_translation: George the Fifth by the Grace of God King of all the Britains

reverse.description:
Crowned quartered shield of arms within Garter band, legend around, divided date below.

Note: crown touches shield, important to distinguish 1922 issues.
reverse.lettering:
· FID: DEF: IND: IMP: ·
HALF · 19 21 · CROWN
HONI SOIT· QVI MAL· Y PENSE·
reverse.lettering_translation:
Defender of the Faith Emperor of India
Shame on he who thinks evil of it

comments:
The standard weight of these coins was 5/11 troy ounce (218.2 grains), unchanged from the earlier sterling silver issues.

Krause & Mischler divide this series into two reverse varieties:
KM#818.1a (1920-22) crown touches shield;
KM#818.2 (1922-26) groove between crown and shield.

Other sources indicate a total of three obverse and four reverse dies:
Obverse 1 small head in high relief;
Obverse 2 medium head, 24½mm and away from 'A: B', wide spaced 'REX';
Obverse 3 large head, 25mm, low relief, wide spaced 'REX';
Reverse A raised garter edge above 'F·19', colon of 'DEF' points to pearl;
Reverse B small design, plain edge above 'F·19' forming a pocket above 'C';
Reverse C plain garter edge above 'F·19', colon of 'DEF' points to pearl in crown;
Reverse D groove between crown and shield, legend close to garter, colon of 'DEF' points to space;

1926 obverse die varieties:
KM#818.2 188 small beads around, colon after BRITT points between beads;
KM#830 145 large beads around, colon after BRITT points to a bead;
